articleTitle: Disc Replacement vs. Microdiscectomy: What It Means When Your Surgeon Skips the Smaller Surgery
imageHeadline: Why Your Surgeon Skipped Microdiscectomy for Disc Replacement
imageSubtext: What that recommendation actually means for your spine surgery decision
pinTitle: Disc Replacement vs Microdiscectomy: Understanding Your Surgeon's Recommendation
pinDescription: When your surgeon recommends disc replacement over the smaller microdiscectomy procedure, it tells you something important about your spine condition. Learn what factors drive this decision and the key questions to ask before moving forward with surgery.
